title: chore(core): remove to-factory
body:
**Summary**

The impact this module is having on our code base is negligent, but it takes up space, and can be removed since it's so trivial.

**Result**

This save a little bit of space (.1 / .05 kb gz)

fixes #3327

**Build before**

```
~/g/instantsearch.js (develop|✚1) $ yarn build
yarn run v1.12.3
$ yarn run build:cjs && yarn run build:es && yarn run build:umd
$ BABEL_ENV=cjs babel src --out-dir cjs/ --ignore src/index.es.js,__tests__,__mocks__ --quiet
$ BABEL_ENV=es babel src --out-dir es/ --ignore src/index.es.js,__tests__,__mocks__ --quiet && BABEL_ENV=es babel src/index.es.js --out-file es/index.js --quiet
$ BABEL_ENV=umd rollup --config scripts/rollup.config.js

src/index.js → dist/instantsearch.development.js...
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                    │
│   Destination: dist/instantsearch.development.js   │
```
